title: Final Scattering Matrix
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the scattering matrix S.

title: Determinant Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the determinant of the matrix M as det M = k_1 / k_3.

title: Transmission Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the leftward transmission coefficient T_l.

title: Continuity Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply continuity conditions for the wavefunction and its derivative at the potential boundaries.

title: Matrix Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student should express the relationships between wave coefficients in matrix form accurately.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when calculating coefficients or determinants.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all quantities are expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show clear and correct algebraic manipulation when deriving expressions.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student could provide a physical interpretation of the results, such as discussing the implications of the transmission coefficient.
